news.title: Brigham and Women's nurses set Nov. 12 date for open-ended strike

news.title: Philips sets aside $322M for proposed DOJ settlement over sleep apnea device recall

news.title: Rhythm doubles down on LG obesity license, raising payout to as much as $855M

news.title: AbbVie abandons phase 2 solid tumor drug over ‘limited benefit’
news.summary: AbbVie has scrapped a phase 2 solid tumor drug after deciding that the monoclonal antibody was unlikely to best the current standard of care, Fierce has learned.

news.summary: Abbott has posted positive 30-day results from its Tectonic trial of the investigational SonicForce Coronary IVL System in coronary artery disease (CAD), but analysts urge caution on results.

news.title: OpenAI-funded Biossil snags Theriva's unwanted antibiotic degrader portfolio for up to $91M
news.summary: Canada's OpenAI-backed startup Biossil Labs has extended its pharma shopping spree with a deal worth up to $91 million for Theriva Biologics' deprioritized early- to mid-stage portfolio of antibiotic-degrading enzymes.

Large language model-based client simulators often rely on clinically organized case descriptions, which can encourage responses explaining the client's difficulties more clearly than their current understanding warrants. papers.title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
papers.summary: Coding agents increasingly rely on automated approvers to decide whether a proposed shell command may run. Existing approvers, from rule-based checkers to guardrail models and deployed permission classifiers, base their decisions on the text of the request and command. Yet a command's behavior depends on the code it invokes and the state of the workspace, and systems that observe file changes leave the assessment to the agent or a human after execution. papers.title: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate image generation and visual understanding, but are existing single-pathway unlearning methods sufficient to suppress target concepts across both? In this work, we study cross-pathway concept unlearning. Our goal is to prevent a model from both generating images of a target concept and identifying it in input images, while preserving other capabilities. To this end, we introduce UUBench, a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 target concepts and 60 semantically related neighboring concepts.
